title: 第十四章 在百货商场买买买
slug: 抢恶姐婚约随军被禁欲大佬亲哭
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

她穿着件杏色针织衫，素雅干净，衬得她皮肤白了些，人也看上去温柔了不少，下身穿着条修身的窄版牛仔裤，勾勒出纤细笔直的长腿，脚上踩着一双亮面圆头皮鞋。

她微微歪头看他，眉眼弯弯，露出浅浅梨涡。

沈时觐心里莫名的恸了下，脸颊发烫。

现在的她，真的……很好看。

林栀还没来得及去照镜子，可她从沈时觐的表情里读懂了自己选的这身衣服很合适。

她几步走到柜台前，冲售货员豪气地挥了下手：“这套衣服和鞋子我全要了，一共多少钱？”

“稍等！”售货员熟练地拨了拨算盘珠子，笑着抬起头来：“羊毛针织衫是26块，裤子是18块，小牛皮的鞋子是36块，一共是80块钱。”

80块钱？林栀皱了眉。

她在沈时觐这里一个月才拿50块钱，这身衣服差不多就要了她两个月的工资，有点小贵。

不过想到沈时觐刚才看她的眼神，她又觉得值了。

她从口袋里掏出那一摞钱来，数出八张大团结放到柜台上。

售货员原本觉着她身上穿的衣服寒酸，见她付钱十分爽快，身旁又跟了个一看就不普通的好看男人，立刻跟她推销起了才到的那件驼色羊毛大衣。

她把大衣平放在柜台上，抬手轻轻摸了摸上面的纹路，笑眯眯道：“小姑娘，这是今早才到的羊毛大衣，质量款式都是最好的，我们商场就这一件，穿出去也不会撞衫，你要不要试试？”

林栀上手摸了摸，这衣服质地不错，一看就是纯羊毛的，款式就是放到现代来说，也不俗气。

售货员见她有意，立刻撺掇她穿上试试。

有哪个女人会不喜欢漂亮衣服呢？林栀倒也没推辞，大大方方的伸手接过穿在了身上。

这衣服又轻又暖和，有一种被暖风包裹着的感觉。

她很满意。

可转念想到这个年代羊毛大衣的稀缺，她直愣愣地问：“这大衣要多少钱？”

售货员冲她笑笑：“小姑娘，你刚才也摸过这料子了，这是实打实的羊毛，不扎身、不板硬，冬天挡风抗寒，就是穿个十年八年的都不会起球变形。”

林栀见她铺垫这么多，心想这衣服一定不便宜。

她问：“那要多少钱？”

售货员顿了顿，冲她伸了伸手指头。

林栀看她伸出来三根手指，立刻皱了眉。

这衣服是好衣服，可是价钱更好。

三百块啊，顶她半年工资了，这也太奢侈了。

她抿了抿唇道：“这衣服款式不太适合我，颜色也有些浅了，算了，我不要了。”

说着就把身上的羊毛大衣脱了下来，刚想让售货员把衣服挂回去，一旁的沈时觐就开了口：“这衣服我们要了。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

She wore an apricot-colored knitted sweater, which was elegant and clean. It made her skin whiter and made her look much gentler. She wore a pair of slim-fitting narrow jeans on her lower body, which outlined her slender and straight long legs. On her feet, she wore a pair of shiny round-toe shoes.

She tilted her head slightly to look at him, her eyebrows curved, revealing a slight dimple.

Shen Shijin felt inexplicably sad and his cheeks felt hot.

She is really... pretty now.

Lin Zhi didn't have time to look in the mirror, but she understood from Shen Shijin's expression that the clothes she chose were suitable.

She walked to the counter in a few steps and waved her hand proudly to the salesperson: "I want all these clothes and shoes. How much is the total?"

"Wait a minute!" The salesperson flipped the beads on the abacus skillfully and looked up with a smile: "The woolen sweater is 26 yuan, the pants are 18 yuan, and the calfskin shoes are 36 yuan. The total is 80 yuan."

80 yuan?Lin Zhi frowned.

She only gets 50 yuan a month from Shen Shijin, and this outfit costs her almost two months' salary, which is a bit expensive.

But thinking about the way Shen Shijin looked at her just now, she felt it was worth it.

She took out the pile of money from her pocket, counted out eight large coupons and put them on the counter.

The salesperson originally thought that the clothes she was wearing were shabby, but when he saw that she was very happy to pay, and there was an unusually good-looking man beside her, he immediately started selling her the camel wool coat that he had just arrived.

She laid the coat flat on the counter, raised her hand and gently touched the lines on it, and said with a smile: "Little girl, this is a wool coat that just arrived this morning. The quality and style are the best. This is the only one in our store. It won't look like a dress when you wear it. Do you want to try it?"

Lin Zhi touched it and saw that the clothes were of good quality. They looked like pure wool and the style was not tacky even in modern times.

Seeing her interest, the salesperson immediately encouraged her to try it on.

What woman doesn’t like beautiful clothes?Lin Zhi didn't refuse, and generously reached out to take it and put it on.

The clothes are light and warm, and it feels like being wrapped in warm wind.

She was satisfied.

But then she thought about the scarcity of wool coats in this era, and she asked blankly: "How much does this coat cost?"

The salesperson smiled at her: "Little girl, you have touched this material just now. This is real wool. It is not tight or stiff. It can withstand wind and cold in winter. Even if you wear it for ten or eight years, it will not pill or deform."

Seeing how much preparation she had made, Lin Zhi thought that these clothes must not be cheap.

She asked: "How much will it cost?"

The salesperson paused and stretched out his finger at her.

Lin Zhi saw her holding out three fingers and immediately frowned.

These clothes are good clothes, but the price is even better.

Three hundred yuan, which covers half a year's salary for her, is too luxurious.

She pursed her lips and said, "The style of this dress doesn't suit me very well, and the color is a little too light. Forget it, I don't want it anymore."

As he spoke, he took off his woolen coat. Just when he wanted the salesperson to hang the clothes back up, Shen Shijin on the side said, "We want these clothes."
